newsitem.title: USA: Prudential Insurance to sell off real estate - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Prudential Insurance to sell off real estate - WSJ.

text.p: Prudential Insurance Co of America plans to sell off $5.6 billion in hotels, office buildings and other real-estate holdings, the Wall Street Journal reported Thursday.
The article quotes Prudential senior managing director John Strangfeld as saying the company expects to own less that $2 billion of real-estate assets when the liquidation is complete.
The insurer will adopt a strategy of investing in securitized mortgages, real-estate investment trusts (REITs) and private real-estate funds run by investment banks, the article said.
